title: Doctor Strange and the magic cloak.
lines: Stephen was a very good doctor.
He operated on people with his hands.
He was clever, but also a bit of a show-off.
One day Stephen had a car accident.
Someone told him about a place far away, in the mountains.
He knocked on a big wooden door.
The wise teacher of the wizards.
I can teach you magic, she said.
But you'll have to learn to listen well.
The Ancient One said: Breathe calmly.
Golden circles came out of his hands.
In the library Stephen found a red cloak.
And the cloak helped him when he was in danger.
Sometimes the cloak even wiped away his tears.
One day a dark cloud came over the city.
Strange little monsters came out of it.
They wanted to eat all the colours.
Doctor Strange flew there with his cloak.
He made a big shield of golden light.
A round little gateway of sparks.
Whoosh, the monsters flew through it.
His hands were still shaking a little.
He had learned that he didn't have to be perfect.
He only had to be good.
The cloak gave him a little pat on the shoulder.
